plugins.name: voice-toolkit

plugins.name: writing-toolkit

plugins.name: document-toolkit
plugins.description: Research a person into a sourced PDF brief, and lay out documents that look designed, not generated.

plugins.name: secure-core
plugins.description: The secure-launch front door: maps a repo's attack surface (routes, auth, outbound fetches, paid APIs and their spend caps, secrets by name, data stores, deploy targets), runs every applicable check in the suite, and writes one findings ledger where each check is PASS, FAIL or UNKNOWN. Required by every other secure-launch plugin.

plugins.name: secure-secrets
plugins.description: Keep secret values out of repos and out of captured sessions: a gitleaks scan proven on planted keys, values never printed; a staged PreToolUse guard that blocks commands which print secrets; a capture-folder scanner; and a per-provider rotation runbook with a shape check that never displays the value. Requires secure-core.

plugins.name: secure-supply-chain
plugins.description: Dependency risk without auto-bumps: production npm audit with per-advisory reachability triage recorded in the repo, lockfile presence, GitHub Actions pinned to SHAs with secrets scoped per step, wrangler pinned, and a check that the BUILT code resolves and loads under plain Node (vitest resolves differently). Requires secure-core.

plugins.name: secure-app
plugins.description: App-layer security for your builds: ASVS-lite checks (credentialed CORS, stack traces in responses, debug routes, sign-out that only clears the browser, object writes without an ownership reference), outbound-fetch guard against SSRF, abuse and spend (uncapped paid APIs, unset caps that mean unlimited, open proxies, per-client ceilings, caller-set LLM params), and tests proven by removing each protection. Requires secure-core.

plugins.name: secure-platform
plugins.description: One adapter per supported platform, each stating what it checks and what it cannot see: Cloudflare Pages and Workers (headers on every path, no secrets in [vars], previews off production data, edge hardening), Next.js on OpenNext (server actions, NEXT_PUBLIC_ secrets, static-export headers), Fly and Supabase (RLS, service-role key, [env] secrets, exposed ports), Google Apps Script (web app access, scopes, keys in code) and Railway (environment dumps, count-only variable reads). Requires secure-core.

plugins.name: secure-gate
plugins.description: Enforce the secure-launch ledger: a gate that refuses on FAIL and on any UNKNOWN the owner has not accepted, and drop-in templates (GitHub Actions workflow, deploy-script gate, pre-push hook) vendored into a repo only on request. Requires secure-core.
